title: Forms and validation UX: inline on blur, summarised on submit, accessible error binding
description: Form fields validate inline on blur and re-validate on change after a first failure. Submission failures render a submit-level summary listing every failed field with links to each. Error text is programmatically tied to its field via aria-describedby. Required fields are marked visibly and programmatically. Personal-data fields carry autocomplete tokens. Mobile keyboards match field intent via inputmode and type attributes.
rationale: Forms are where users do the work that matters. Validation timing, error binding, and keyboard intent are the difference between a form that helps and a form that blames.
